---
title: "Plan mensual"
---

```{=html}
<div class="tf-page-header">
  <div>
    <h1>Plan mensual</h1>
    <div class="tf-muted">Consolidado automático del mes: lo planificado, lo realmente ejecutado y el origen de cada valor.</div>
  </div>
  <div class="tf-actions">
    <span class="tf-plan-save-state">Consolidado automático</span>
    <button class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" data-logout>Cerrar sesión</button>
  </div>
</div>

<section class="tf-card tf-monthly-plan-overview">
  <div class="tf-budget-period-nav" aria-label="Mes visible del plan">
    <button id="monthly-plan-prev" type="button" class="tf-icon-button" aria-label="Mes anterior">‹</button>
    <button id="monthly-plan-period-label" type="button" class="tf-budget-period-label">—</button>
    <button id="monthly-plan-next" type="button" class="tf-icon-button" aria-label="Mes siguiente">›</button>
  </div>
  <button id="monthly-plan-today" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary tf-btn-compact" type="button" hidden>Ir al mes actual</button>
  <input id="monthly-plan-month" type="hidden">

  <div class="tf-plan-dual-summary">
    <section class="tf-plan-summary-panel">
      <div class="tf-section-kicker">Plan del mes</div>
      <div class="tf-plan-summary-line"><span>Ingresos previstos</span><strong id="mp-kpi-income">$0,00</strong></div>
      <div class="tf-plan-summary-line"><span>Compromisos</span><strong id="mp-kpi-fixed">$0,00</strong></div>
      <div class="tf-plan-summary-line"><span>Objetivos</span><strong id="mp-kpi-saving">$0,00</strong></div>
      <div class="tf-plan-summary-line"><span>Reservas</span><strong id="mp-kpi-variable">$0,00</strong></div>
      <div class="tf-plan-summary-line is-result"><span>Disponible</span><strong id="mp-kpi-free">$0,00</strong></div>
    </section>
    <section class="tf-plan-summary-panel">
      <div class="tf-section-kicker">Ejecución real</div>
      <div class="tf-plan-summary-line"><span>Ingresos reales</span><strong id="mp-real-income">$0,00</strong></div>
      <div class="tf-plan-summary-line"><span>Egresos de caja</span><strong id="mp-real-expense">$0,00</strong></div>
      <div class="tf-plan-summary-line"><span>Pagos de tarjeta</span><strong id="mp-real-card">$0,00</strong></div>
      <div class="tf-plan-summary-line"><span>Préstamos pagados</span><strong id="mp-real-loan">$0,00</strong></div>
      <div class="tf-plan-summary-line is-result"><span>Flujo registrado</span><strong id="mp-real-net">$0,00</strong></div>
    </section>
  </div>
</section>

<div id="monthly-plan-warning" class="tf-alert tf-alert-error"></div>

<section class="tf-card tf-plan-table-card">
  <div class="tf-section-heading"><div><div class="tf-section-kicker">Entrada</div><h2>Ingresos previstos</h2><div class="tf-muted">Ingresos recurrentes, contratos y facturas que corresponden al mes.</div></div><strong id="mp-income-total" class="tf-plan-section-total">$0,00</strong></div>
  <div class="tf-table-wrap"><table class="tf-table tf-plan-table"><thead><tr><th>Ingreso</th><th>Origen</th><th>Fecha prevista</th><th class="tf-num">Monto</th><th>Estado</th></tr></thead><tbody id="mp-income-list"></tbody></table></div>
  <div id="mp-income-empty" class="tf-empty" hidden>Sin ingresos previstos para este mes.</div>
</section>

<section class="tf-card tf-plan-table-card">
  <div class="tf-section-heading"><div><div class="tf-section-kicker">Obligaciones</div><h2>Compromisos</h2><div class="tf-muted">Recurrentes, préstamos, tarjetas, seguros y otros pagos previstos.</div></div><strong id="mp-fixed-total" class="tf-plan-section-total">$0,00</strong></div>
  <div class="tf-table-wrap"><table class="tf-table tf-plan-table"><thead><tr><th>Compromiso</th><th>Origen</th><th>Fecha</th><th class="tf-num">Monto</th><th>Estado</th></tr></thead><tbody id="mp-fixed-list"></tbody></table></div>
  <div id="mp-fixed-empty" class="tf-empty" hidden>Sin compromisos previstos para este mes.</div>
</section>

<section class="tf-card tf-plan-table-card">
  <div class="tf-section-heading"><div><div class="tf-section-kicker">Construcción financiera</div><h2>Objetivos</h2><div class="tf-muted">Aportes sugeridos desde Metas y otros objetivos con aporte mensual.</div></div><strong id="mp-saving-total" class="tf-plan-section-total">$0,00</strong></div>
  <div class="tf-table-wrap"><table class="tf-table tf-plan-table"><thead><tr><th>Objetivo</th><th>Tipo</th><th>Referencia</th><th class="tf-num">Asignado este mes</th></tr></thead><tbody id="mp-goal-list"></tbody></table></div>
  <div id="mp-goal-empty" class="tf-empty" hidden>Sin objetivos con aporte mensual para este mes.</div>
</section>

<section class="tf-card tf-plan-table-card">
  <div class="tf-section-heading"><div><div class="tf-section-kicker">Dinero no libre</div><h2>Reservas del mes</h2><div class="tf-muted">Presupuestos y reserva de IVA. Este dinero reduce el disponible libre del mes.</div></div><strong id="mp-variable-total" class="tf-plan-section-total">$0,00</strong></div>
  <div class="tf-table-wrap"><table class="tf-table tf-plan-table"><thead><tr><th>Reserva</th><th>Origen</th><th class="tf-num">Base</th><th class="tf-num">Reservado</th><th>Referencia</th></tr></thead><tbody id="mp-variable-list"></tbody></table></div>
  <div id="mp-variable-empty" class="tf-empty" hidden>Sin reservas aplicables a este mes.</div>
</section>

<dialog id="monthly-plan-month-dialog" class="tf-tx-category-dialog tf-budget-month-dialog">
  <div class="tf-tx-category-dialog-head"><div><div class="tf-section-kicker">Período</div><h3>Seleccionar mes</h3></div><button id="monthly-plan-month-dialog-close" type="button" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary">Cerrar</button></div>
  <div class="tf-budget-year-nav"><button id="monthly-plan-year-prev" type="button" class="tf-icon-button" aria-label="Año anterior">‹</button><strong id="monthly-plan-picker-year">2026</strong><button id="monthly-plan-year-next" type="button" class="tf-icon-button" aria-label="Año siguiente">›</button></div>
  <div id="monthly-plan-month-grid" class="tf-budget-month-grid"></div>
  <div class="tf-actions" style="margin-top:.8rem"><button id="monthly-plan-picker-current" type="button" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary">Mes actual</button></div>
</dialog>

<script type="module" src="js/monthly-plan.js?v=1.0.85"></script>
```
